overview: 今日共收录9篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Breaking the ice: Scientists use attracting particles to form an anti-spin ice
full_list.title_zh: 破冰：科学家利用吸引粒子形成反旋转冰
full_list.abstract: In a recent Nature Communications study, researchers have reported the realization of an anti-spin ice, a system that does the opposite of conventional spin ices by breaking the ice rule that governs them.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在《自然通讯》最近的一项研究中，研究人员报告了一种反自旋冰的实现，该系统通过打破控制自旋冰的冰规则来与传统自旋冰相反。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在《自然通讯》最近的一项研究中，研究人员报告了一种反自旋冰的实现，该系统通过打破控制自旋冰的冰规则来与传统自旋冰相反。
full_list.summary: 在《自然通讯》最近的一项研究中，研究人员报告了一种反自旋冰的实现，该系统通过打破控制自旋冰的冰规则来与传统自旋冰相反。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《破冰：科学家利用吸引粒子形成反旋转冰》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Ultracold atoms simulate hard-to-observe matter-antimatter pair production
full_list.title_zh: 超冷原子模拟难以观察的物质-反物质对的产生
full_list.abstract: According to quantum electrodynamics, the theory describing interactions between light and electrically charged particles, a sufficiently strong electric field can, in principle, convert some of its energy into particles and their antimatter partners. A particle's antimatter partner has the same mass and, for electrically charged particles, the opposite electric charge.
full_list.abstract_zh: 根据描述光和带电粒子之间相互作用的量子电动力学理论，足够强的电场原则上可以将其部分能量转化为粒子及其反物质伙伴。粒子的反物质伙伴具有相同的质量，对于带电粒子来说，具有相反的电荷。

full_list.abstract: As quantum computers grow more ambitious, many researchers believe the best way forward is to build them in multiple interconnected parts. In these modular designs, separate quantum processors are linked so they can work together as one larger machine. For this to happen, however, connections must carry fragile quantum information without destroying it.

full_list.title_en: From Enterprise Institutional Documents to Editable Process Models: A Hybrid LLM-Rule-Engine Architecture for Enterprise Governance
full_list.title_zh: 从企业制度文档到可编辑流程模型：企业治理的混合法学硕士-规则-引擎架构
full_list.abstract: Enterprise institutional documents encapsulate substantial process‑oriented management knowledge. Transforming them into structured editable process models constitutes a foundational task for business process management (BPM) and governance‑risk‑compliance (GRC) digitalization. However, manual process modeling is time-consuming, inconsistent across practitioners, and difficult to maintain, while existing automated approaches—whether rule-based methods grounded in traditional natural language processing (NLP) or recent large language model (LLM) generation methods—cannot simultaneously satisfy the dual requirements of semantic understanding accuracy and output format conformance, and typically lack deep integration with enterprise approval systems. Following the design‑science‑research (DSR) paradigm, this paper proposes, implements, and deploys a hybrid LLM and rule‑engine architecture (LRHA) for automatically generating organization‑compliant editable process models from enterprise institutional documents. The architecture decomposes the transformation task into six stages—text parsing, element extraction, logic modeling, rule matching, JSON generation, and draft output—with the LLM handling the first three stages that rely on semantic understanding and the rule engine handling the latter three stages that rely on deterministic constraints, thereby separating semantic interpretation from format enforcement. For Chinese enterprise institutional texts, we derive a set of “textual cue to process element” mapping rules and define a JointJS-oriented process model representation specification together with ten executable quality validation rules. Distinct from generic text-to-BPMN methods, LRHA provides native support for enterprise governance capabilities at the architectural level, including institutional‑text ambiguity resolution, compliance constraint validation, asynchronous integration with existing approval OA systems, version traceability, and audit trail preservation. The system has been deployed in production within the risk control information system of a large energy enterprise group, achieving end-to-end automated integration with the group’s OA system through asynchronous task interfaces (task submission, status query, multi-file download, and proactive callback), underpinned by HMAC signature verification and idempotency mechanisms. Case evaluation shows that for complex processes with over 40 nodes and edges, manual modeling work is reduced from several days to approximately 20 minutes, requiring only minor manual fine‑tuning. Large‑scale quantitative benchmark evaluation remains as future work. This paper makes four contributions: (1) it proposes and validates the division of labour and collaboration mechanism between LLMs and rule engines in automated process model generation; (2) it constructs a mapping rule system and executable quality validation specification tailored to Chinese enterprise institutional texts; (3) it natively implements enterprise‑governance‑oriented architectural capabilities for institutional‑text ambiguity resolution, compliance constraint validation, OA‑system integration, version traceability, and audit‑trail preservation; and (4) it reports the complete deployment pathway and engineering experience of the hybrid architecture within an enterprise information system, offering a replicable reference paradigm for similar organizations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 企业制度文件包含了大量面向流程的管理知识。将它们转换为结构化可编辑流程模型构成了业务流程管理 (BPM) 和治理风险合规性 (GRC) 数字化的基本任务。然而，手动流程建模耗时、从业者之间不一致且难以维护，而现有的自动化方法——无论是基于传统自然语言处理（NLP）的基于规则的方法还是最近的大语言模型（LLM）生成方法——无法同时满足语义理解准确性和输出格式一致性的双重要求，并且通常缺乏与企业审批系统的深度集成。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 企业制度文件包含了大量面向流程的管理知识。将它们转换为结构化可编辑流程模型构成了业务流程管理 (BPM) 和治理风险合规性 (GRC) 数字化的基本任务。然而，手动流程建模耗时、从业者之间不一致且难以维护，而现有的自动化方法——无论是基于传统自然语言处理（NLP）的基于规则的方法还是最近的大语言模型（LLM）生成方法——无法同时满足语义理解准确性和输出格式一致性的双重要求，并且通常缺乏与企业审批系统的深度集成。本文遵循设计科学研究（DSR）范式，提出、实施和部署混合法学硕士和规则引擎架构（LRHA），用于从企业机构文档自动生成组织兼容的可编辑流程模型。该架构将转换任务分解为六个阶段：文本解析、元素提取、逻辑建模、规则匹配、JSON 生成和草稿输出，LLM 处理依赖于语义理解的前三个阶段，规则引擎处理依赖于确定性约束的后三个阶段，从而将语义解释与格式执行分开。针对中国企业制度文本，我们推导了一套“文本线索到流程元素”的映射规则，并定义了面向JointJS的流程模型表示规范以及十个可执行的质量验证规则。与通用的文本到 BPMN 方法不同，LRHA 在架构层面为企业治理能力提供原生支持，包括机构文本歧义解决、合规性约束验证、与现有审批 OA 系统的异步集成、版本可追溯性和审计跟踪保存。该系统已在某大型能源企业集团风控信息系统中投入生产，通过异步任务接口（任务提交、状态查询、多文件下载、主动回调），通过HMAC签名验证和幂等机制，实现与集团OA系统的端到端自动化集成。案例评估表明，对于超过40个节点和边的复杂流程，手动建模工作从几天减少到大约20分钟，只需要少量的手动微调。大规模的定量基准评估仍是未来的工作。本文有四个贡献：（1）提出并验证了法学硕士和规则引擎在自动化流程模型生成中的分工和协作机制； （2）构建适合中国企业制度文本的映射规则体系和可执行的质量验证规范； (3) 原生实现面向企业治理的架构能力，用于解决机构文本歧义、合规约束验证、OA系统集成、版本可追溯和审计跟踪保存； (4)报告了企业信息系统内混合架构的完整部署路径和工程经验，为类似组织提供可复制的参考范例。
